_readme: Symptom -> cause -> fix, the 17 rows of docs/research/R3_Script_structures.md, mapped to metric conditions on metrics.py names (raw: views, reach, likes, comments, saves, shares, skip_rate, profile_visits, follows, link_clicks; computed: retention = watch-through, sends_per_1k_reach, saves_per_1k_reach, skip_rate_vs_median). median_ratio / median_delta compare with Numa's trailing same-format median (strategy.py). R3's thresholds are directional (no official benchmarks); rows R3 states as trends ('rising across Reels', 'bookings low', 'comments mostly ask about outcomes') are flagged by the nearest per-post condition and the symptom says what to check by hand. strategy.py diagnose lists the rows a post matches; the Strategist puts the fix in the brief and the Scriptwriter applies it on the series' next post.

diagnosis.symptom: Skip rate well above Numa's median (R3: or roughly 50%+).
diagnosis.cause: The opening frame is static, a logo or an establishing shot; the hook only works with sound.
diagnosis.fix: Open mid-action on a face or motion; add a 5-8 word text hook in frame 1; test two hooks as Trial Reels.

docs/research/R1_Hooks.md (skip rate measures the first 3 seconds; official)

diagnosis.symptom: Skip rate far above the median (R3: rising across consecutive Reels; check the last three).
diagnosis.cause: The same first shot, host angle or hook template every time (recognition skips).
diagnosis.fix: Rotate opening shot types: POV, close-up, overhead, text-on-black for at most 1 s.

diagnosis.symptom: Skip rate low but retention well below the median (a cliff at 3-8 s).
diagnosis.cause: The hook promises something the next beat doesn't deliver; slow setup.
diagnosis.fix: Cut the setup; put the first payoff by 5-6 s; restate the promise in text.

diagnosis.symptom: Retention dips mid-Reel while the hook holds.
diagnosis.cause: A dead beat: a long static shot, a rambling line or repeated information.
diagnosis.fix: Trim that segment; a visual change every 2-4 s; move the strongest beat earlier.

diagnosis.symptom: Average watch time under about 30-40% of the length.
diagnosis.cause: The Reel is longer than its idea; too many words a second or talk over visuals.
diagnosis.fix: Cut 20-30% of the runtime; about 2.5 words a second; let the visuals carry the payoff.

diagnosis.symptom: Average watch time over 100% of the length but reach below the median.
diagnosis.cause: A good loop, but the hook doesn't stop cold viewers, or the topic is too niche.
diagnosis.fix: Keep the loop; strengthen the first-frame text; broaden the identity angle.

diagnosis.symptom: Retention fine, reach stuck at followers.
diagnosis.cause: Low sends per reach; the content speaks to insiders only.
diagnosis.fix: Add a 'send to [specific person]' payoff; universal framing (relatable POV, comparison, local guide); avoid Numa jargon.

diagnosis.symptom: Reach suddenly far below the median on one post.
diagnosis.cause: Not eligible for recommendations: watermark, border, mostly text, muted, reposted footage, engagement-bait caption.
diagnosis.fix: Re-export clean original footage; remove 'tag/share/comment YES' language.

diagnosis.symptom: Sends per 1,000 reached well under about 5 (R3: wellness stretch about 10).
diagnosis.cause: No clear recipient; the payoff is informative but not socially useful.
diagnosis.fix: Name the recipient ('your plunge buddy'); add a relatable POV or a shared plan (an event date).

diagnosis.cause: Not a reference; nothing specific worth returning to.

diagnosis.fix: Post more faces, regulars and staff (day in the life, founder, event recap); reply to comments.

diagnosis.cause: The bio is unclear (what, where, how to book) or the grid shows no series.
diagnosis.fix: Rewrite the bio: what, Midtown Mobile, how to book; pin three Reels (explainer, first-timer reaction, event teaser).

diagnosis.symptom: Follows fine but link clicks low.
diagnosis.cause: The CTA is buried; link-in-bio friction; several CTAs.
diagnosis.fix: One CTA per post, repeated in on-screen text and the caption's first line; a Story link sticker.

diagnosis.symptom: Link clicks high (R3: but bookings low; check bookings in the monthly campaign review).
diagnosis.cause: The landing page doesn't match: the offer isn't visible, no times shown.
diagnosis.fix: Deep-link to the exact offer or event with a time picker; match the post's wording on the page.

diagnosis.symptom: Comments well above the median (R3: read them: mostly 'does it help with ___?').
diagnosis.cause: Viewers infer health promises from the edit.
diagnosis.fix: Remove implied-outcome visuals and words; answer with what's included plus 'ask your provider'; make a reply-to-comment Reel.
